name: application-color-picker
title: Color Picker
description: Swatch grid and hue/saturation panel color pickers with hex and RGB inputs for theming and design tooling in web applications.
useWhen: Swatch grid and hue/saturation panel color pickers with hex and RGB inputs for theming and design tooling in web applications.
avoidWhen: Avoid color picker when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Color Picker uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Associate each form field with a visible or programmatic label before production use.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
